ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of child care fraud cases in Minnesota and Texas
questions: What are the most common schemes used in child care fraud?
How much money is involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of child care fraud cases, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities. This could lead to a larger investigation and potential recoveries of fraudulent funds.
